For the Appellant : Mr. Ajit Kumar, Sr. Advocate Mr. Kushal Kumar, Advocate Mr. Krishna
Prajapati, Advocate For the State : Mr. Sharad Kaushal, Ac to Aag-Iii For the Nhai : Mrs. Sweety
Topno, Advocate Mr. Amrit Raj Kisku, Advocate

The instant appeal is under Clause-10 of Letters Patent directed against the order dated
10.01.2023 passed by the learned Single Judge in W.P. (C) No. 5575 of 2021.

2. The issue which was before the learned Single Judge that even though, the delay has been caused
by the National Highway Authority in making payment of the amount of compensation in lieu of
acquisition of the land under the National Highways Act, the interest to the tune of Rs. 29,57,277/-
has not been paid.

3.  Mrs. Sweety Topno, learned counsel appearing for the NHAI has submitted that there is no delay said to be caused on behalf of the NH Authority and hence, the NH Authority is not liable to make payment of interest.
4. The further submission has been made that it is the Special Land Acquisition Officer who has caused the delay.

5. It needs to refer herein that as per the N.H.A.I. Act, 1956, the Land Acquisition Officer is not the functionary of the State Government, hence, whatever amount of interest is to be paid, it is by the NH Authority.

sentences.text: Mrs. Sweety Topno, learned counsel appearing for the N.H.A.I., upon this, has sought for two weeks' time to file detailed affidavit showing the claim of interest not to be paid in favour of the writ petitioner on the ground there is no delay said to be attributable to the N.H. Authority.
7. Considering the same, let this matter be listed on 12.06.2024, so that, the affidavit be filed as per the prayer made by the learned counsel for the N.H. Authority.
